info.name: Student ID - Discord DMs Service
info.description:
Discord DMs Service (Go), REST reached through the Gateway on {{baseUrl}}. Lab 4: no mocks. Every permission comes from the real Session Service through the Message Broker (session.verifyMembership, published over gRPC from Lab 4 Task 8), so {{sessionId}} must be a real session in which the moderator and junior tokens hold the listed channel assignments (junior 1: #enrollment-check and #general-mod-chat; junior 2: #faculty-check and #general-mod-chat), and its ShiftStarted must have been delivered to DMs through the Message Broker (event.ShiftStarted.v1) so the default channels exist. The old internal /api/v1/internal/... stand-ins are removed. WebSocket: negotiate through the Gateway with the same token and connect to the returned URL.

Authentication: every request sends Bearer the appropriate private player token, a real access JWT of that player (Player login, or a disposable local test signer whose public key the Gateway and DMs are configured with). The Gateway verifies it and sets X-Player-Id from its subject, so this collection sends no X-Player-Id: identity cannot be chosen by the client. Keep tokens in a private Postman environment, never in tracked files. The health request uses no authentication. Lab 4 folders: Task 3 Gateway boundary, Task 4 operational logs (log-download endpoint), Tasks 5-8 Message Broker (topics, events, topic listing). HTTP topic publication tests exercise the Broker compatibility ingress; native gRPC publication uses messaging.proto. Broker-to-service gRPC delivery requires a matching transport catalog and healthy receivers.

item.name: Lab 4 Task 3 - Gateway boundary
item.description: Gateway public boundary checks for discord-dms-service. Keep baseUrl pointed at the Gateway: players reach only the public /api/v1 routes; internal operations are never routed.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthenticated access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Gateway rejects a malformed bearer: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: Lab 4 Task 4 - Operational logs
item.description: Start the local log-download endpoint (scripts/log_download.py) for the exact running Compose project. Set logDownloadUrl and a private logDownloadToken; this is a separate operations credential, not a Player JWT. The download is limited to discord-dms-service and its declared numeric replicas; omit the service query on the same endpoint for the whole system.

exec: pm.test('Exporter is UP', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('UP'); });

request.description: A finite text attachment from the selected Compose project. Use Save Response to keep it privately. A 503 means the local Docker/configuration source is unavailable.

exec: pm.test('Owned service snapshot includes the requested bounds', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.include('services=discord-dms-service'); pm.expect(text).to.include('since=15m; tail=200 per container'); });

pm.test('Operations authentication error is traceable', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHORIZED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); });
pm.test('Invalid query uses the operations contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('INVALID_LOG_QUERY'));

item.name: Lab 4 Tasks 5-8 - Message Broker
item.description: Service-to-service messaging through the Message Broker (grades 5-8). Run where brokerBaseUrl reaches the Broker on the private network (for example newman inside the Compose network, http://message-broker:8093). The tokens are Broker CALLER credentials of the named services, supplied privately; never commit them. gRPC (Task 8: MessageBroker on :9093, MessageConsumer.Deliver on DMs' :9080) uses contracts/proto/studentid/messaging/v1/messaging.proto in Postman's gRPC requests, which the v2.1 collection format cannot carry; the HTTP publication API below reaches the same topics, so the Broker delivers to DMs over gRPC once transports.json names discord-dms-service grpc.

request.description: Lab 4 Grade 7: GET /internal/v1/messaging/topics with a Broker caller credential. gRPC MessageBroker.ListTopics returns the same listing.

exec: pm.test('Every reviewed topic, sorted', () => { const names = listing.topics.map(t => t.topic); pm.expect(names.length).to.eql(44); pm.expect(names).to.eql([...names].sort()); });

pm.test('event.ShiftStarted.v1 has a ready discord-dms-service subscriber', () => { const t = listing.topics.find(x => x.topic === 'event.ShiftStarted.v1'); pm.expect(t).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(listing.discovery).to.eql('UP'); pm.expect(t.subscribers['discord-dms-service'].ready).to.be.above(0); });
